data.name: Enhanced Personality
data.description: An ambassador gains a Charisma score equal to the typical Intelligence score of a familiar of its level, if that would be higher than its normal Charisma score. The familiar's Intelligence score remains 6 (or its normal starting Intelligence for an improved familiar) and doesn't increase by level.
